preliminaryCodeObservations.qualifier: These are numbers read from source control points, NOT measurements of the evaluated GLB mesh. The inspected public GLB includes simplified wheel cylinders; source control points do not establish exported geometry.

notes: Do not equate source-control-point comparisons, GLB metadata, or an AI-generated subjective score with a verified 95/100 visual acceptance.
